missions.objective: Choose and compare expressive sound contrasts in a short original story.
missions.learnerControl: Choose sounds and whether the partner's quieter/louder response fits the story.
steps: Explore and stop sounds using comfortable controls.
Make a short sound idea; an adult can help with operation.
Choose which version to hear and indicate a preference or intention.
Hear a partner reply with a checked dynamics change.
Create a different sound story and share with a chosen listener.
missions.independentEvidence: A fresh intentional sound choice or accessible response; adult observation if not captured.
missions.doNotInfer: Reading ability, rhythmic precision or emotional state.
missions.contextActivity: Discuss when and where people use sound/music; use authorised examples supplied by the educator.
missions.curriculumCoverage: proposed_partial; not a complete band programme

missions.objective: Hear and use a rest within a repeating phrase while keeping its time structure.
missions.learnerControl: Choose a phrase and a sound position to leave silent.
steps: Hear and make a short pattern.
Predict what happens if one sound is silent.
Hear a checked version and compare.
Choose listening, slower practice or a larger control if helpful.
Use a fresh pattern without teaching hints and share a rhythmic response.
missions.independentEvidence: Listening discrimination and actual played timing recorded separately; do not credit construction as live performance.
missions.doNotInfer: That a timing difference reveals the cause of difficulty.
missions.contextActivity: Discuss musical conversations and occasions for group music using appropriately sourced examples.
missions.curriculumCoverage: proposed_partial; not a complete band programme

missions.objective: Recognise and control a melodic relationship while preserving a rhythmic pattern.
missions.learnerControl: Choose an original phrase, direct a higher/lower reply and decide how to develop it.
steps: Create a short melodic phrase.
Choose a supported transposition direction or compare two proposals.
Verify the reply keeps its time pattern and changes permitted pitches.
Describe or demonstrate what changed.
Rehearse and perform a fresh learner-created response with appropriate support.
missions.independentEvidence: A new comparison or controlled musical response without teaching hints; representation/input support retained.
missions.doNotInfer: Correct fingering or a universal aesthetic ranking.
missions.contextActivity: Explore a teacher-authorised example of musical purpose/context; First Nations material needs its own permissions and review.
missions.curriculumCoverage: proposed_partial; not a complete band programme

missions.objective: Organise motifs into a purposeful form and justify a structural decision.
missions.learnerControl: Own two musical ideas, choose their order and accept or reject a partner arrangement.
steps: Compose two short ideas, A and B.
Predict an effect of changing section order.
Compare a checked ordering that preserves both ideas internally.
Revise the form and optionally add a separate labelled partner part.
Document, rehearse and explain a new arrangement for a chosen audience.
missions.independentEvidence: A fresh structural choice and explanation with authorship/support visible.
missions.doNotInfer: That adding texture changes only one perceptual property or demonstrates instrumental technique.
missions.contextActivity: Discuss how musical choices communicate meaning and sustain cultures; use authorised, contextual material.
missions.curriculumCoverage: proposed_partial; not a complete band programme

missions.objective: Investigate multiple interpretations or arrangements and defend an independent musical decision.
missions.learnerControl: Choose constraints, critique the partner and retain final authority.
steps: Select or create original musical material.
Specify a clear arrangement goal and constraints.
Compare the model proposal with a learner-designed alternative.
Reject or revise, and explain the musical consequences.
Complete a new independent arrangement or analysis.
missions.independentEvidence: An independently justified decision; analytical depth can increase without raising motor demands.
missions.doNotInfer: Complete secondary/senior-course achievement or tertiary conservatoire equivalence.
missions.contextActivity: Research style/context with verified sources; no impersonation of named artists or restricted cultural material.
missions.curriculumCoverage: proposed_partial; not a complete band programme
